title: What's Being Done
grammar: Verbal nouns in -ás/-és; recap of azért, hogy + subjunctive
goal: I can turn a verb into a noun with -ás or -és, like újrahasznosítás.
I can say why something is done with azért, hogy and a verb in -jon/-jen.
I can talk about sustainability with four new words, such as energiatakarékosság and zöld átállás.
I can say that recycling and saving energy are important for nature.
